newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tingyi first half sales up 58 pct - papers.
newsitem.headline: Tingyi first half sales up 58 pct - papers.

text.p: Instant noodle maker Tingyi (Cayman Islands) Holding Corp posted a 58 percent rise in sales in the first six months of 1996 but its profit margin was slightly lower than last year, local newspapers said on Monday.
But the company maintained its forecast of between 20 to 30 percent growth on net profits for the year, the Hong Kong Economic Journal quoted Tingyi's managing director as saying in Tianjin.
The China-based Taiwanese company will announce its interim results on Spetember 9.
Tingyi's newly developed beverage products were expected to post a loss of below US$1.0 million instead of US$5.0 million as estimated in August, the Hong Kong Economic Times reported.
Shares of the company dropped sharply in late July on institutional selling triggered by talk that the counter had been downgraded by Merrill Lynch.
The brokerage later issued a report that it downgraded Tingyi to accumulate from buy and revised down its annual profit forecast to 685 million yuan, up 15 percent from a year earlier.
